trust_decision.summary: Whether caller-supplied MathML text may declare/load an external DTD and entities when parsed; decided only in MathML::read, which calls loadXML with LIBXML_DTDLOAD and no DOCTYPE screening.

landing_point.why: Summary names the MathML reader; the only parser call with LIBXML_DTDLOAD in the tree is this line.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API PhpOffice\Math\Reader\MathML::read(string) (scanner call added before str_replace, fix.diff:60)
new helper PhpOffice\Math\Reader\Security\XmlScanner::scan, called only from MathML::read

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix touches only MathML::read plus two new files; no second implementation, wrapper or save/reload path is changed.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: OfficeMathML::read (src/Math/Reader/OfficeMathML.php:38-39) parses a different format (OMML) without LIBXML_DTDLOAD, so a solver can argue it is a neighbouring format already safe under libxml defaults and outside a 'MathML' report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate MathML input carries '<!DOCTYPE math PUBLIC ... mathml2.dtd>' and the named entity ⁢ (rewritten to <mchar>), which must keep parsing; a fix that rejects every DOCTYPE or strips entity handling breaks the documented example and existing tests. The published scanner whitelists '<!DOCTYPE math' for this reason.

O6_input_shapes: DOCTYPE with external SYSTEM identifier (php://filter / data: wrapper) loaded via LIBXML_DTDLOAD (fix.diff:178)
UTF-16/NUL-interleaved '<!DOCTYPE' spelling, matched by the \0* regex (fix.diff:98-103)

O7_producer.where: No schema/serializer/cache/config producer; input string goes straight from caller to loadXML (src/Math/Reader/MathML.php:25-38).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: OfficeMathML reader parses caller XML with a bare DOMDocument::loadXML and gets no DOCTYPE screening; the published fix did not touch it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different format (OMML) and no LIBXML_DTDLOAD/NOENT flag, so libxml defaults already prevent external DTD/entity loading; arguably not exploitable.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: OMML reader passing LIBXML_DTDLOAD (or LIBXML_NOENT) to loadXML to resolve Word-specific entities, without the scanner.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The MathML reader in the same directory already does exactly this for ⁢ (src/Math/Reader/MathML.php:27-38); a maintainer mirroring it for OMML entities is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Semantics annotation-xml content re-parsed into a fresh DOMDocument with DTDLOAD, after the scanner has run on the outer string.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Semantics/annotation support was just added (6ea0c81); re-parsing nested annotation XML would bypass a scanner that runs only on the outer input — a how-type check-then-use split.

O10_build.toolchain: composer + phpunit (^7.0 || ^9.0); PHP ^7.1|^8.0 with ext-dom, ext-xml

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop LIBXML_DTDLOAD in MathML::read only (one-line change), leaving OfficeMathML unscreened and no DOCTYPE check.

out_of_scope_notes: Published scanner allows any input containing '<!DOCTYPE math' anywhere (fix.diff:103), so a DOCTYPE named 'math' with an internal subset passes the scan; mitigated only by the removed DTDLOAD flag.
unverified: Whether OfficeMathML::read with default flags is reachable for any external DTD/entity load on PHP 7.x (libxml_disable_entity_loader off) — believed not, not executed.
